name: Dexio
description: Your shared Dexio wiki as agent memory: recall before each turn, and tools to search, read and write the pages your other agents and team use.

apiKey.label: Dexio API key
apiKey.help: Make one in Dexio under Settings > Agents (https://app.dexio.wiki/settings/agents). Or set DEXIO_API_KEY.

url.label: Server
url.help: Change it only for a self-hosted Dexio. Or set DEXIO_URL.

autoRecall.label: Recall before each turn
autoRecall.help: Search the wiki for the user's message and put the matching pages in front of the model. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess.

agentName.label: Name on changes
agentName.help: The name Dexio records on this agent's changes. Defaults to the OpenClaw agent id, or openclaw for the main agent.
